morphology.pattern_note: 英语人名，整词记忆；不存在马来语词缀拆分。所列 IPA 为英式英语读音，实际读法尊重本人。

senses.zh_definition: 卡莉：英语中通常用作女性名字的专名。
senses.en_definition: A personal name, usually feminine, used in English.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas orang yang lazimnya digunakan sebagai nama perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 正文写作 Carly，首字母大写；不是具有普通词义的马来语词汇。下列搭配是自然使用框架，不代表已有频率统计。输入未提供 DBP 释义；此处马来语释义为编写释义，status 沿用指定格式，不表示获得 DBP 认证。人名属性与读音参见 [Behind the Name: Carly](https://www.behindthename.com/name/carly)。

dual_scenarios.context: 职场汇报：介绍项目负责人
dual_scenarios.ms: Carly akan menyelaras projek ini dan membentangkan laporan kemajuan pada minggu hadapan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 卡莉将协调这个项目，并于下周汇报进展。
dual_scenarios.en: Carly will coordinate this project and present a progress report next week.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Carly dah sampai kat kafe ke?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Adakah Carly sudah tiba di kafe?
dual_scenarios.en: Has Carly got to the café yet?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, dia tunggu kat dalam. Kita masuk je.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, dia sudah tiba dan sedang menunggu di dalam. Mari kita masuk sahaja.
messages.zh: 到了，她在里面等着。我们直接进去吧。
messages.en: Yes, she's waiting inside. Let's just go in.

etymology.historical_story: Carly developed as a feminine form of Carl in English naming traditions. The singer Carly Simon helped increase its popularity during the 1970s. In a Malay sentence, however, it identifies a person rather than contributing an ordinary lexical meaning. Its ending should therefore not be analysed as a Malay suffix. [Source: Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/carly).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Carly /ˈkɑː.li/ 近似“卡莉”：想象朋友向卡莉挥手，直接把声音与人名相连。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 朋友间可直接称 Carly；正式场合应按对方认可的姓名和称谓称呼，不凭名字推定婚姻状况或头衔。
